description: Stoa advertises eventSourceUrl but never wired it. Skip SSE and go straight to WebSocket per RFC 8887. Provides server-initiated StateChange push for Email/Mailbox/Thread, request pipelining over a single persistent connection, and eliminates polling. This is the standard JMAP real-time transport — not chat-specific. Supersedes stoa-a4gn7 (EventSource) as the preferred push mechanism.
title: Implement JMAP over WebSocket (RFC 8887)
